::: {#exr-word-letters}
#### Letters in words

Let $W = \set{\text{cat}, \text{dog}, \text{owl}}$ be a set of words
and $L = \set{\text{c}, \text{d}, \text{o}, \text{t}}$ a set of letters.
List the ordered pairs $(w, x)$ in the Cartesian product $W \times L$ (@def-cartesian-product)
for which the letter $x$ appears in the word $w$.

:::
